gen-gf-crafty-girls-fs-bespoke-serif: Bespoke Serif reads with authority and dignity, its thin strokes about half the weight of the thick ones. Crafty Girls loosens it, and a light sampling feels pleasant enough.
gen-gf-crafty-girls-fs-epilogue: Crafty Girls writes casually, its bowls unclosed and inviting, with no pinching anywhere in the curves. But Epilogue is the one for steady text, its curvy monoline lowercase tall-bodied with stubby ascender tips.

gen-gf-crafty-girls-fs-fira-sans: Loose handwriting, tidy text: Crafty Girls leads with unclosed, inviting bowls and no pinching at the curves. Fira Sans follows in sans-serif with a larger-than-usual x-height and s curves open wide at both ends.
gen-gf-crafty-girls-fs-public-sans: Public Sans reads hefty and trustworthy, with broad counters on c and s. Crafty Girls leads in casual, relaxed handwriting, with a signage-like plainness running through every line weight.

gen-gf-crafty-girls-general-sans: Casual scribble, smooth finish: Crafty Girls keeps its bowls unclosed and inviting, with no pinching. Then General Sans fills the line top to bottom, so paragraphs glide along on smooth, unobstructed curves.
